name: Back to the Beginning
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
I suppose that this is goodbye then, my friend. But, I'll always be here if you want to come back and talk with me from time to time. Probably while you're loitering around waiting for your buddies to join you for a raid on Blackrock Spire.

Go, before I start to cry. Go back to Deliana in Ironforge and tell her what's happened.
narrative.objectives: Speak with Deliana at The High Seat in Ironforge.
narrative.offerRewardText:
I am very happy to see you return to me safely, adventurer. You look well, if not a bit worse for the wear.

Come, tell me of all that has transpired.
